items.title: Excel Data Cleansing (2026)
items.description: Cleaned and standardized 3,600+ sales records by resolving duplicates, missing values, inconsistent text, and date formats to create reliable data for analysis.

items.title: Excel Formula Analysis (2026)
items.description: Applied Excel functions including SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, MIN, MAX, SUMIF, SUMIFS, IF-ELSE, and INDEX-MATCH to analyze, retrieve, and summarize business data.

items.title: Excel Sales Dashboard (2026)
items.description: Built an interactive sales dashboard using Pivot Tables, Slicers, Filters, and Report Connections to visualize key sales information and support data-driven decisions.

items.title: Life Insurance Reserve Analysis (2026)
items.description: Compared joint life endowment insurance reserves using CIR and Hull-White models with 25 years of interest rate data, achieving MAPE of 12.30% and 13.40%

items.title: PSO-XGBoost Bankruptcy Prediction (2025)
items.description: Developed an XGBoost bankruptcy prediction model optimized with PSO, improving accuracy from 83.68% to 93.30% and AUC from 0.8194 to 0.8772.

items.title: Health Insurance Renewal Prediction (2025)
items.description: Developed a Naïve Bayes model to predict group health insurance policy renewals, achieving 82% testing accuracy through data preprocessing, feature selection, and model evaluation.

items.title: Financial Statement Analysis (2025)
items.description: Analyzed PT Asuransi Bintang Tbk’s 2021–2023 financial performance, identifying declining operating cash flow, debt exposure, and unstable underwriting profitability through financial ratios.

items.title: Pension Funding Analysis (2025)
items.description: Calculated Normal Contribution, Actuarial Liability, and UAL using the Accrued Benefit Cost Method and TMI IV, identifying a growing pension funding deficit.

items.title: Health Factors Regression Analysis (2025)
items.description: Analyzed five health factors using regression and 2023 Indonesian Health Survey data, with selected variables explaining 83.17% of diabetes prevalence variation.

items.title: Insurance Reserve Forecasting (2024)
items.description: Forecasted general insurance premium reserves using ARIMA and 2016 – 2023 data, selecting ARIMA(1,1,1) and estimating January - March 2024 reserves of 24,319,169 – 24,905,093.

items.title: Financial Accounting Analysis (2023)
items.description: Applied basic accounting principles by preparing general journals, ledgers, adjusting entries, and closing entries from financial transactions.
